columns.name: publisher_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the publisher.

columns.name: publisher_name
columns.description: Name of the publisher.

columns.name: num_books
columns.description: Number of books published by the publisher, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_books_pages_greater_than_70_per_of_avg
columns.description: Number of books with more than 70% of the average number of pages of all books, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_Japanese_books
columns.description: Percentage of books published by the publisher that are written in Japanese.

columns.name: title_of_the_oldest_book
columns.description: Title of the oldest book published by the publisher, with ties broken by the ascending order of the title.

columns.name: book_title_with_the_most_pages
columns.description: Title of the book with the most pages published by the publisher, with ties broken by the descending order of the title.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Name of the customer. Concatenate the first name and last name with a space in between.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email of the customer.

columns.name: per_books_over_13
columns.description: Percentage of the books whose price is over $13 among all the books ordered by the customer.

columns.name: num_orders
columns.description: Number of orders placed by the customer, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: preferred_shipping_method
columns.description: the shipping method that is preferred by customers the most, with ties broken by the ascending order of the shipping method name.

columns.name: has_ordered_the_oldest_book
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has ordered the oldest book; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: per_order_shipped_internationally
columns.description: the percentage of orders placed by the customer that were shipped internationally

columns.name: author_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the author.

columns.name: author_name
columns.description: Name of the author.

columns.name: first_book
columns.description: Title of the first book written by the author, with ties broken by the ascending order of the title.

columns.name: per_book_published_1992
columns.description: the percentage of books published by the author in 1992

columns.name: wrote_fewer_total_pages_than_the_average
columns.description: Set to 1 if the author has written fewer total pages than the average total pages of all authors; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: most_expensive_book
columns.description: Title of the most expensive book written by the author, with ties broken by the descending order of the title.

columns.name: avg_book_price_over_19
columns.description: Set to 1 if the average sale price of the books written by the author is over $19; otherwise, set to 0.

config:
Airbyte:
  config:
    files_definition_id: 778daa7c-feaf-4db6-96f3-70fd645acc77
    mongodb_definition_id: b2e713cd-cc36-4c0a-b5bd-b47cb8a0561e
    namespace_definition: destination
    postgres_definition_id: decd338e-5647-4c0b-adf4-da0e75f5a750
    s3_definition_id: 69589781-7828-43c5-9f63-8925b1c1ccc2
    server_url: http://airbyte-abctl-control-plane:80/api/public/v1/
    redshift_definition_id: f7a7d195-377f-cf5b-70a5-be6b819019dc
aws_s3:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: test
  AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-west-2
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: http://elt-localstack:4566
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: test
  data:
  - path: s3://books-bucket/country.csv
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    table: country
  - path: s3://books-bucket/shipping_method.csv
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    table: shipping_method
custom_api:
  config:
    configuration: {}
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - book_author
    - book_language
    - publisher
flat_files:
- format: jsonl
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1Bq1Izwp4uzD1p9f7ybviABunBKngExlp
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: address_status
- format: csv
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=11Z4G9zRi2X7GoaxXLo2fLv57shxFw2uY
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: order_status
mongodb:
  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    database: books
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - author
    - book
    - customer
postgres:
  config:
    database: books
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - address
    - cust_order
    - customer_address
    - order_history
    - order_line
    user: postgres
redshift:
  config:
    host: <redshift_hostname>
    port: <redshift_port>
    database: <redshift_db>
    username: <redshift_username>
    password: <redshift_pwd>
    schema: books
    s3_bucket_name: <redshift_s3_bucket>
    s3_bucket_region: <redshift_s3_region>
    access_key_id: <redshift_s3_access_key>
    secret_access_key: <redshift_s3_secret_key>
